titles.title: Bear Lake, New Mexico

description: Small vertical canvas dominated by a large tree with a white trunk centered through the middle.  The trunk blends from white to grey from the bottom up, with the rest of the canvas above filled with the dark green of the foliage.  On the bottom left are two red tree trunks, and one red tree trunk on the right. Through the branches are hints of blue evening sky with little white dots as stars.
